Akroor represents the ideal king who rules with wisdom, justice, and strength. historical_references.reference: Akroor was a king of the Pallava dynasty in the early 8th century CE who is believed to have built the Shore Temple at Mahabalipuram.

Another Akroor, a king of the Chalukya dynasty, is mentioned in the 11th-century Kannada literature 'Aadipurana'. He is described as a great patron of Jainism and is believed to have ruled in the late 10th or early 11th century CE.
